caption: The drawing features three bird figurines arranged in a horizontal line against a plain, light-colored background. On the left is a rooster, painted with black, white, and gray feathers, a red comb and wattle, a yellow beak, yellow legs, and a green and brown base under its feet. In the center, there is a small bird depicted in side profile, colored in shades of brown with yellowish undertones, a slim body, and thin legs. On the right, there is a large parrot-like bird featuring primarily green feathers with dark shading, a pale orange face, yellow around the beak, and reddish areas near the head, perched on a blue and green cylindrical base with two visible legs. The composition is simple with the three birds evenly spaced and facing each other on a neutral background.
title: Wooden Birds
